name: Undead Potatoes
summary: Oran Snakewrithe seeks magical works for the library in Undercity's Magic Quarter. Your discoveries help expand its collection and knowledge.

sections.title: For the Collection
sections.body: In Undercity's Magic Quarter, Oran Snakewrithe asks whether you have brought something to add to the collection. Magical works may benefit the library, and she welcomes more such discoveries as its knowledge grows.

faq.answer: Oran Snakewrithe asks for magical works that might benefit the library's collection.
The collection is kept by Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity's Magic Quarter.
Your efforts help expand the library's knowledge.
